9/23/2024
It's been 3 years sense i wrote this first review back in 2021 as someone who had only put 7 hours into the game at the time and but had seen a lot of media surrounding it at the time. I Just wanted to come back and say that after 3 years and over 2,000 hours in this game i stand by what i said and more. 

This game has its issues weather its performance related or how un optimized certain features are among other things. But if you look past those and you start getting into some of the communities in this game you'll find that its a pretty friendly and welcoming place most of the time. There are bad apples when it come to groups here and as a player of this game you regrettably have to navigate these areas, If that scene is what your looking for. 

NOW! 
for what i believe makes this game an enjoyable experience it comes down to how much freedom that you are given when it comes to both modding and playing base game. For example you could play as a modern US Riflemen in Afghanistan fighting against hostile forces, Or on the flip side you could be a Guardsman From War hammer 40k fighting Chaos cultist and warp monsters. 

There is also the sand box feel of the game with the mission Creator interface (Eden) and also the Zeus interface which both allow you to create missions for you and your friends to play. both with their own unique systems and functions and with similarity as well. 

The last thing ill say about the game is that its differerent for everyone but its still something that i think people should give a shot even with its short comings. and if your on the fence about it because of money just wait for a sale. with how old the game is from what ive seen the sales are rather big on it so your likely to get it for at least 50% off or even more depending. 

(Thats my bit about it, thanks for reading hope it helps)

I love this game I wish that you could make a French Forgin Legion loadout like the one you see in the Old man Campagin and that for the old man Campagin that you could do co op. but I wish that u could make the Forgin Legion loadout in game and also have the French Famas as well.

Best in its class if you like the mil-sim genre. Unique in it's scale and scope. There's also a ton of mods and custom scenarios if you get done with the base game; as well as access to the scenario editor. 

It excels at infantry and combined arms gameplay, and there's plenty of depth for those who like to pilot jets, helicopters, tanks, light vehicles, etc.

Currently in love with the new Vietnam community-made DLC's multiplayer co-op "MIKE" mission.
With these hours The Nam is perfect timing.
